# Prospects: healthcare — doctors and clinics

Read with `universal.md`. Healthcare is the most policed vertical in search
(YMYL) and the most regulated for advertising in India (NMC / MCI ethics
code on solicitation). Every tactic here is editorial or registry-based;
nothing here buys placement, incentivises a review, or makes a claim a
reviewer could not stand behind.

Link type key: **F** followed · **N** nofollow · **M** mention/entity only.

## Profiles engines read first (claim, complete, keep NAP identical)

| Target | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Practo | N | The most-cited Indian doctor platform in AI answers; complete bio, qualifications, timings, fees; reviews accrue here |
| Google Business Profile | M | Primary category exact (e.g. Dermatologist), services, hours, photos; the review corpus lives here |
| Justdial, Sulekha | N | Entity confirmation; keep the phone number identical |
| Lybrate, Credihealth, DocPrime-style aggregators | N | Claim and correct; stale profiles with old addresses split the entity |
| Bing Places, Apple Business Connect | M | Same NAP |
| WhatClinic / medical-tourism aggregators | N | Only if international patients are a segment |

## Registers and professional bodies

| Target | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|
| State Medical Council register (e.g. Telangana State Medical Council) | M | Public verification of registration number — put the number on the About page |
| IADVL and its state branch (dermatology); the equivalent specialty association | F | Member directories; conference speaker pages (DERMACON, state CMEs) |
| IMA local branch | F/M | Office-bearer pages, camp announcements |
| Hospital "consultants" / visiting-consultant pages | F | Every hospital the doctor is empanelled with |
| Medical college alumni pages and department "our alumni" features | F | The college wants the story |
| ORCID, Google Scholar profile, ResearchGate | F/M | For any published work; `sameAs` on the Physician schema |
| Journal author pages | F | Each paper's author affiliation links to the clinic if the affiliation is the clinic |

## Press and expert-quote channels

- Health desks: Mint Lounge, HT Health, The Hindu Health, Indian Express
  Lifestyle, TOI Health; city desks for camps and local stories (Telangana
  Today, Deccan Chronicle, The Hans India, TOI Hyderabad).
- Journalist platforms (Qwoted, Source of Sources, Featured): health
  reporters ask for a specialist quote weekly; seasonal hooks are the
  reliable ones — monsoon fungal infections, summer sun damage, festival
  skin, winter eczema, exam-season hair fall, wedding-season procedures.
- Podcasts and YouTube health channels: guest slots produce a bio link.
- NGO and CSR partners for camps: their event pages link to the clinic.

## Linkable assets this vertical rewards

| Asset | Why it earns links |
|---|---|
| Condition guides with a named medical reviewer, review date, references | the pages other clinics, journalists and forums send readers to |
| Procedure cost reference for the city/country with ranges and what changes the price | the most-searched, least-answered question; forums link to the honest answer |
| Compounded / customised formulation explainers (where the clinic offers them) | rare content; pharmacists and patients cite it |
| A skin-type / hair-loss self-check tool | tools get bookmarked and listed |
| Seasonal skin calendar for the region | evergreen, shareable, updatable each year |
| Patient-consented before/after with method | trust, not links — keep it out of schema and off ad platforms |

## Communities

Reddit: r/IndianSkincareAddicts (large, strict on vendors), r/hyderabad and
other city subs, r/AskDocs (answer as a verified professional only). Quora
health topics. Rules: disclose, answer, never solicit — the NMC code applies
online too.

## What is off-limits here

No paid reviews, no review gating, no testimonials in structured data, no
"best dermatologist in ‹city›" anchors, no links from pharmacy or
supplement affiliates, no guest posts on general health content farms.
Each of those has produced manual actions or council complaints.
